notes.title: Elusive’s new gameplay trailer
notes.content:
Hello Elusive raiders!

We’ve waited a little longer than expected, but we had to do it. And it’s because today we have shown a [b]new trailer with exclusive gameplay at The Indie Media Exchange[/b] Summer Game Showcase.

Check it out!

[previewyoutube=kG8O1N2yMtQ;full](trailer)[/previewyoutube]

The Elusive are very small beings, but full of resources with which to survive and thrive in a world where everything is usually much bigger than they are. 

Among those threats, especially when exploring the outside of the house, is the raven. This raven has a very bad temper, without a doubt, but it also seems to be affected by something strange that makes it even more dangerous. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/0483add4a6da1621206164d9b9aa689919ae5cd6.png[/img]

[h3]Interactions with large animals in Elusive[/h3]

While being the size of a pencil has its benefits, it is certainly a disadvantage when there are large animals around. And by big animals, we mean “harmless and funny” (if you’re human, of course) [b]creatures like a crow or a cat[/b].

These two animals will be our biggest threats during our raids, and it’s because the Elusive are part of their diet, as would other small animals such as mice or insects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/d40762e97b2590682ab381425ba2c249eb09a6b9.jpg[/img]

The crow relentlessly watches the outside of the house, where the garden and other intermediate areas are located. The outside offers less protection and we will have to be especially cautious when moving between plants and branches, but we will also have to be prepared to confront it directly if things get complicated!

Although they will be moments of great tension, these chases and confrontations will also be a great opportunity to test our combat, stealth and platforming skills, and show what the Elusives Raiders are capable of!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Share the development path of Elusive with our community on [url=https://discord.gg/hmKfXen9FC]Discord[/url], where we share new exclusive content, ask you all about what would you like to see in the game and hang out together!

And [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519500/Elusive/?beta=1]add Elusive to your wishlist[/url] — It means a lot to us!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519500/Elusive/?beta=1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/3fbbd1c11785bd1bc74e1103c6ca306451e074ff.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Inspirations behind Elusive’s development
notes.content:
Hello elusive little friends! Come out of your hideouts for a moment please, we want to share something with you. 

In the time left until the release of Elusive, we want to share things about the project and its development, not only the progress and improvements, but also about the talented team that is working on it. Today we will talk about [b]how the idea of this game came up[/b] and the works that have inspired it. 

Although I'm sure you can already imagine some of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/e55b78351594cd0f5358c56eb6ed39f2382b135a.png[/img]

[h3]The fantasy of being tiny in a huge world[/h3]
There is [b]something captivating in the idea of feeling very, very small[/b] and that everything around you, especially things that in your day to day life are so normal that you don't even notice them, is so much bigger. 

The world becomes a great ([i]no pun intended hehe[/i]) adventure, especially if you have tools and skills with which to explore and overcome dangers and obstacles. The meaning and potential of things changes: a small needle can now be a powerful weapon, a big button, a new table for your house, and with a piece of bread you can eat the whole month 🍞 

In part, this is a new but familiar feeling that brings back memories of childhood. The world seemed wider for our small size and we didn't yet have all the fears and doubts we acquired as adults. It brings back a reckless, but addictive feeling!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/7f317fdb0aebfd6c85bf3db5112f5eea8af3aeb4.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Secret World of Arrietty, The Borrowers and It Takes Two [/h3]
This concept is not new, of course, and these are just some examples of great and wonderful works that have done an excellent job with the idea of being little kids living great adventures ([i]again, sorry haha[/i]).

At Chibig we have always taken Studio Ghibli as a reference when creating our games, especially for the beautiful visuals and the way their stories touch the heart. [b]The Secret World of Arrietty[/b] has inspired us a lot to create our own aesthetics, but also some very interesting elements for game mechanics, like the needle-sword.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/e296cd3922ab305cfa9fd1b04113cc7a7bf9e12e.jpg[/img]

As good 80-90’s kids, [b]The Borrowers[/b] have a special place in our hearts, and now also in Elusive's ideation. This film shows us not only this fantasy, but also the feeling of community and family. 

Being so small in an environment where everything can potentially be a threat can make us feel alone and helpless, but if there are more people like you and you can support each other, you can not only survive, but enjoy and thrive together. 

Of course, [b]It Takes Two, but also Ori and the Blind Forest or The Plucky Squire[/b] are video games that have created incredible experiences with this premise, and that have inspired us (and will continue to inspire us in this development path) to create our own. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[url=url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519500/Elusive/?beta=1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/3fbbd1c11785bd1bc74e1103c6ca306451e074ff.png[/img][/url]

Although we can't give you more details yet, we‘ll be able to show you new unreleased content of Elusive very soon. You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519500/Elusive/?beta=1]add the game to your wishlist[/url] to follow our updates and join our [url=https://discord.gg/hmKfXen9FC]Discord server[/url] to discover more content of the project and talk to us.

For now, we wish you a happy and fruitful raid!

notes.title: First time testing Elusive on Steam Deck
notes.content:
Hello [i]elusive[/i] friends! 

The announcement of Elusive has been very well received so we couldn't help but put together the most advanced work to date (still WIP) and test it on Steam Deck. Here's the result!

[previewyoutube=7V1spH5r2-o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What have you seen? [/h3]

Elusive [b]combines 3D and 2D (2.5D) scenarios[/b], so in the 3D scenarios we will have a [b]free camera[/b] to appreciate all our huge environment, but also to explore more easily in our search for resources and treasures. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519500/Elusive/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/486f67cf829a03236bba2c7fad765869007a1860.jpg[/img][/url]

The [b]Memories[/b] are some very well hidden collectibles that will reveal details about the Elusive, the history of Zoe and her father or winks to other adventures from Chibig. 

If you have played [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1819460/Mika_and_The_Witchs_Mountain/]Mika and the Witch's Mountain[/url], you will quickly recognized the Memory that appears in the video!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519500/Elusive/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/05f9ff6d78a90727ed9e25eb7379a8cebf8ae22a.jpg[/img][/url]

You've also seen Zoe cracking open a walnut, but why? These [b]nuts hide very useful gadgets for Zoe[/b], like a hook or special boots. Just a few seconds before we can see Zoe using the hook to get around an obstacle, and thanks to it she can access an area she couldn't reach otherwise. 

During your adventure you will have to search and find these equipment upgrades if you want to reach every corner of this huge house. And you should want to, [b]you are Elusive raiders after all[/b]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519500/Elusive/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/dc591c023f3f17d9bcdfbbe99ea63bd6fa71dc06.jpg[/img][/url]

Even though it was short, we're excited to see Elusive running on a platform like Steam Deck - it makes us feel closer to fully play it too!

For now, [b]wishlists are heartily appreciated[/b], but you can also go one step further on our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/abraham-cozar/elusive?ref=2gozas]Kickstarter campaign[/url], which is only a few days away from ending.

Watch your steps!

notes.title: HEY! New adventure called Elusive here
notes.content:
Hi! 

We’re Chibig, a small indie gamedev team from Spain behind other games like Summer in Mara, Mika and the Witch’s Mountain, Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara, Deiland Pocket Planet and Ankora Lost Days. 

And this is our new adventure: ELUSIVE 🌱

[previewyoutube=sZsgIJEuPP4;full][/previewyoutube]

Elusive is the story of Zoe, a young Elusive raider exploring a giant’s house following the steps of her father. Humans are HUGE and clumsy, so Elusives are almost invisible to them — which is perfect to borrow anything you might need, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/030c6d34ec53361fa24a196dc79f9301cb893626.png[/img]

[h3]Raid by day, Lair by night[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/bda37466273dc0bc2e1fcfec4544ec1caedb9f87.jpg[/img]

Elusive raiders, like Zoe, feel the call of adventure and they’re always exploring every nook and cranny (even digging their own trails) to find tools to improve their equipment, knowledge about the world of giants and resources for their tiny community. 

But they also need to take a break! Find new Elusives to join the Red-Watering Can shelter, a new Elusive community. Merchants, artisans, farmers... everyone can lend a hand. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527509/ed11cba35fd8eeaa04a9429e612859578d28ed1a.jpg[/img]

We'll be revealing more about Elusive, but for [b]now your wishlist[/b] or support on Kickstarter will be very valuable!

Watch your steps!
